title: Internationalisation and energy efficiency: old-paper replication

source.notes: Mirip dengan paper kita sebelumnya hanya Ganti tahun…

question: How does environmental performance change after a factory starts exporting, importing, or receiving foreign investment?
rationale: Replicate the previous paper transparently, while distinguishing its sustained-entry clock from a first-observed-entry estimand.
scope: Full exact Word row, interpreted through repository minimum checks and current owner full-plan ning/full-row acceptance gates. All analysis below is planned, not executed.
unit_of_analysis: Verified establishment-year and verified entry-cohort×calendar-year cells.

target_estimands.name: Primary requested target
target_estimands.formula: ATT(g,t) = E[q_it(1)-q_it(0) | G_i=g]; theta_k = sum_g w_gk ATT(g,g+k)

symbols.i: a verified establishment, never a row-number or artificial linkage
symbols.V: value added deflated with a certified appropriate price index; any single-output-deflator approximation is named
symbols.Y: gross output deflated with its certified output-price index
symbols.E: scope-defined verified physical energy in GJ; incomplete observed subtotals are separately named
symbols.C: scope-defined verified CO2 in metric tonnes; not automatically all greenhouse gases
symbols.L: workers under an annually verified employment definition
symbols.X: predetermined measured covariates declared for the particular design
symbols.g: verified treatment-entry cohort in calendar years
symbols.S: a verified trade, ownership, industry, or survival state; unknown is retained as unknown
symbols.q(1),q(0): potential outcomes under the declared entry path and counterfactual path
symbols.G_i: first qualifying observed entry date, not known first-ever participation
symbols.ATT(g,t): average treatment effect for eligible cohort g in year t
symbols.w_gk: prespecified eligible-treated-count aggregation weight; sums to one over contributing cohorts
symbols.theta_k: weighted effect at calendar event time k

target_estimands.interpretation: ATT(g, t) is the average effect for the eligible entry cohort under its declared counterfactual assumptions; event-time averages use published treated-count weights.
target_estimands.limits: First observed qualifying entry is not first-ever entry. Future confirmation selects stayers. Pretrends cannot prove parallel trends; treatments may reverse or coincide.

finite_model_grid.combination_rule: Primary outcomes run under the registered primary method for each relevant exposure and supported declared calendar/horizon. finite_model_grid.selection_rule: Freeze model_id manifest before execution. Persist every intended cell including source_blocked, unsupported, non converged and omit ted terms. No outcome/covariate/threshold selection by significance.
finite_model_grid.multiple_testing: Two outcomes by three margins by three post horizons = 18 planned tests. Whole event profiles have simultaneous bands. A separate six-test summary family averages all three horizons with equal one-third weights only when all three are supported.

exact_dimensions.cohort_weight_rule: At each horizon, nonnegative cohort weights are the counts of eligible treated establishments in that horizon, divided by the sum of those counts. The fixed-cohort sensitivity requires all k=0,1,2 and holds cohort membership and weights fixed across them.

finite_model_grid.summary_rule: A fixed-window summary requires every declared constituent coefficient and its joint covariance. If any is unavailable, the registered summary is unavailable. code_readability_and_progress_contract.comments: Non-executable Stata comments explain purpose, actual inputs, outputs and failure checks at file, block and subblock levels in simple Indonesian. Do not invent scientific interpretations.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.runtime: Every file, block, subblock, iteration and deepest step prints start, finish or explicit early/error outcome, x/X, percent, elapsed time and exact location; stream live and save the same log.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.clock: Date-aware native Stata wall clock, one-second resolution; preserve scientific timers and fail certification on backward clock.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.semantics: Original operative source remains exactly recoverable; verify r(), e(), _rc, conditional branches and early transfers with a constructed runtime fixture before company execution.
code_readability_and_progress_contract.rerun: A documented launcher must run the actual preparation with visible progress before declaring data prep ready.

wave_input_contract.rule: Every company-data operand in analysis must be the single published consolidated master or a declared derivative whose entire company-data ancestry ends at that consolidated master. Direct annual-wave reads are prohibited in analysis; only the master builder may append annual waves. Raw/staged/legacy/cached final company files cannot be numerical analysis parents. A required field missing from the wave is an upstream preparation failure; never repair it by opening an external company file inside this row. Comparison-only validators may read older data but may not feed construction or estimates. External reference and metadata inputs retain explicit non-company roles.
wave_input_contract.input_release_status: Not certified until actual build, value comparisons and read-boundary checks pass.
wave_input_contract.scientific_gates: All existing field-specific, identity, unit, price, scope and source gates remain binding.
